definitions.explanation: Something happens without anticipation or intention. Often carries a sense of pleasant or neutral surprise.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}いがけず{旧友|きゅうゆう}に{会|あ}った。
examples.english: I unexpectedly ran into an old friend.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}いがけずプレゼントをもらって、とても{嬉|うれ}しかった。
examples.english: I was very happy to receive a gift unexpectedly.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}いがけず{時間|じかん}がかかってしまった。
examples.english: It unexpectedly took a long time.

notes:
FORMATION:
{思|おも}い (thought) + がけ (expectation) + ず (negation)

Literally 'without expecting.'

RELATED FORMS:
・{思|おも}いがけない - unexpected (adjective)
・{思|おmo}いがけなく - unexpectedly (adverb form)

REGISTER:
Neutral to slightly formal. Literary flavor.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{意外|いがい}と/{案外|あんがい} - unexpectedly (focuses on result being different than expected)
・たまたま - by chance, coincidentally
・ふと - suddenly, casually (for thoughts or actions)
